title: lead.scored
description: PAYLOAD of the `lead.scored` envelope. Topic: data.lead.scored. ★ Crown-jewel signal (moat (1)). Emitted by lead-scoring (§9.5) within <=15min of any signal, and RE-EMITTED on every later journey event (re-score). The score is the predicted-value proxy that becomes the CAPI `value` on the Lead event (§11.1 value optimization) so Meta/Google optimize for OUR definition of a good customer. v1 = transparent weighted heuristic; features are ALWAYS stored with the score (training data §9.5). Canonical field shape from Appendix A.

lead_id.description: The lead.captured lead_id this score is for (Appendix A).

person_ref.description: Resolved person_id from the Identity Graph (§8.3) once merged.

score.description: Lead quality 0-100 (Appendix A example: 78). Used as the predicted-value proxy (INR) for value optimization on the CAPI Lead event (§11.1).

tier.description: Bucketed quality (Appendix A). hot triggers the SLA voice call <=60s + QualifiedLead signal (§11.1).

reasons.description: Human-readable drivers (Appendix A: [call_answered_142s, budget_mentioned, asked_location]). Explainability — every score is defensible.

features_ref.description: Pointer to the stored feature vector that produced this score (Appendix A features_ref) — ALWAYS stored as training data (§9.5).

qualified.description: Whether this crosses the QualifiedLead threshold (score>=T_hot OR call_outcome=qualified, §11.1). Drives the QualifiedLead CAPI dispatch + experiment reward (§12.1 reward = qualified leads).

rescore_trigger.description: What journey event caused this (re)score (lead.captured | call.outcome | wa.message.received | booking.created ...).

value_minor.description: Predicted lead value in INR paise sent as the CAPI value (§11.1 value=lead_score as INR proxy).
